nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a, b$ and a list $L$ of pairs of natural numbers, the block index of the list obtained by prepending $(a, b)$ to $L$ consists of the entry $a + 1$, followed by $b - 1$ entries equal to $1$ (none when $b = 0$), followed by the block index of $L$.
nodes.title: Block index of a prepended pair

nodes.summary: The block index of a list $[(a_1, b_1), \dots, (a_r, b_r)]$ of pairs of natural numbers is the index $(a_1 + 1, \{1\}^{b_1 - 1}, \dots, a_r + 1, \{1\}^{b_r - 1})$, where $\{1\}^n$ stands for $n$ consecutive entries equal to $1$ and $b_j - 1$ is truncated at $0$.
nodes.title: Block index of a list of pairs

nodes.title: Nonempty Bradley–Zhao qMZVs have no constant term

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $r$ and $N$, a pair $((m_1, \dots, m_r), (n_1, \dots, n_r))$ of $r$-tuples of natural numbers lies in the set $\mathcal{P}_r(N)$ of partitions of $N$ of length $r$ in Stanley coordinates if and only if $m_1 > m_2 > \dots > m_r$, every $m_j$ and every $n_j$ is positive, and $m_1 n_1 + \dots + m_r n_r = N$.
nodes.title: Membership criterion for partitions in Stanley coordinates

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $r$ and $N$ and every function $a$ from pairs of $r$-tuples of natural numbers to $\mathbb{Q}$, $\sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}_r(N)} a(p) = \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}_r(N)} a(\rho(p))$, where $\mathcal{P}_r(N)$ is the set of partitions of $N$ of length $r$ in Stanley coordinates and $\rho$ is the transpose map.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
